data.exact_reserve_text: The 2021 net technical result of GBP 96.9m (2020: GBP (26.2)m) includes GBP 68.4m (2020: GBP 45.0m) of releases from reserves in respect of prior accident years.
data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2021 the syndicate reported opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 870.49m (the 2020 closing gross claims outstanding). During 2021 there were gross releases from prior accident years of GBP 68.392m (a 7.9% release relative to opening gross claims outstanding), driven by favourable claims development across the portfolio (notably Marine, Property and Energy). Some individual classes (notably Reinsurance and Casualty) experienced minor adverse movements offsetting part of the releases.
raw_causal_phrases: releases from reserves in respect of prior accident years

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (Technical provisions, Claims outstanding) - clear and high confidence. Prior year development taken from Technical Provisions note which explicitly lists 'Total prior year releases' (GBP 68,392k) and supporting per-line split; this is interpreted as GROSS prior-year releases (used here). There is an overall 'Change in claims outstanding' reconciling movement in the reserves table which includes current year movements and was not used for PYD per instructions. No specific named catastrophe events affecting prior years were identified in the text images provided. Reinsurance line in the prior-year split was mapped to 'Treaty' for standard LOB mapping.

_claims_triangle.notes: Claims development table (gross) is present on page 44 but the detailed cell-level extraction was not completed in full; the presence of a full gross triangle was confirmed and page referenced. Development rows were not populated to avoid transcription errors from low-resolution images.
